description: Change a print item — 'put my name and title on the business card', 'use the template band in dark', 'hide the phone number'. Send only what changes; everything else stays. Field names, template ids and limits come from get_print_design. A text longer than its limit is refused, never cut. An empty string makes a field follow the brand again. Check too_long in the answer and shorten what the printer would cut. The user downloads the PDF in PrintStudio.

back.description: Business card only: what the back shows.

fields.description: Texts by field: person, job_title, company, slogan, phone, email, website, address, footnote, qr, headline, text, call_to_action, details, social_handle. On flyer and folder, headline, text, call_to_action and details carry the content.

kind.description: business_card, letterhead, flyer (A5) or folder (A4, tri-fold).

logo_size.description: How large the logo is printed.

scheme.description: How the design is coloured: light background, the brand's accent colour, or dark.

show.description: Switch parts on or off: logo, company, job_title, slogan, phone, email, website, address, extra_lines, footnote, social_handle, text, call_to_action, details, qr.

show_default.description: Parts that follow the template again — undoes an explicit on/off from show (for example after draft_print_design).

window_line.description: Letterhead only: sender line above the address window.

name: update_print_design
title: Change print design
